name: media-organizer
description: Media Organizer — native macOS app to organize iCloud Photos albums and finalize drone footage projects
author: teziovsky

scripts.clean: rm -rf build dist && xcodebuild -project MediaOrganizer.xcodeproj -scheme MediaOrganizer -derivedDataPath build/DerivedData clean
scripts.build: xcodebuild -project MediaOrganizer.xcodeproj -scheme MediaOrganizer -configuration Debug -derivedDataPath build/DerivedData build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
scripts.clean:build: npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.build:production: xcodebuild -project MediaOrganizer.xcodeproj -scheme MediaOrganizer -configuration Release -derivedDataPath build/DerivedData build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
scripts.release: npm run build:production && rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && ditto build/DerivedData/Build/Products/Release/MediaOrganizer.app dist/MediaOrganizer.app && ditto -c -k --sequesterRsrc --keepParent dist/MediaOrganizer.app dist/MediaOrganizer-macOS.zip && echo 'Release artifacts: dist/MediaOrganizer.app dist/MediaOrganizer-macOS.zip'
